subject.title: [Bug]: /hooks/agent silently drops accountId — hook dispatch bypasses cron normalization pipeline

question: Should maintainers keep waiting for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/43951 to be refreshed and proven, or replace it with a credited current-main fix for the hook `accountId` bug?
rationale: The bug remains valid and source-reproducible, but an open closing PR already owns the work and is currently conflicting, uneditable by maintainers, and missing real behavior proof.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that preserves hook `accountId`, ports any delivery-policy intent to current SourceDeliveryPlan code, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep the linked PR as the landing path and wait for the author to rebase, enable maintainer edits or push an update, resolve review findings, and add redacted proof.

options.title: Pause stale branch
options.body: Close or pause the stale PR if maintainers do not want to wait, while keeping this issue open as the canonical bug report.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Open or sponsor a narrow credited replacement that preserves hook `accountId`, ports any delivery-policy intent to current SourceDeliveryPlan code, updates docs, and supplies maintainer-owned proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner is closest in current-main history to the affected gateway hook and SourceDeliveryPlan boundaries that a replacement or refresh must touch.
